title: DSH Mobile Relay v1 frames
description: Strict challenge, heartbeat, commands, scoped session reads, and blocking/timed question frames. File message parts require message.files.v1 on both peers, current Host file.handoff.v1, and atomic database authorization of every reference. Runtime validators reject duplicate file IDs. Archive settlement confirms registry durability, not activity settlement. Fragmented projected payloads are at most 2 MiB.

fileMessageReconcileToHost.description: Host-only message.files.reconcile.v1 query for an already reserved original. Digest remains that of message.submit. It cannot admit a new native prompt. Phone clients cannot send this frame.
